observations.command:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
echo BOOT_BEGIN; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
for f in /proc/kallsyms /proc/config.gz /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/kprobe_events /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/blacklist /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_filter_functions; do
 if test -e "$f"; then echo "PRESENT $f"; ls -l "$f"; else echo "ABSENT $f"; fi
done
echo UART_KPROBE_BLACKLIST
if test -f /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/blacklist; then awk '/uart_insert_char|tty_flip_buffer_push|sdp.*uart|sdp.*rx|uart.*rx/{print}' /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/blacklist; fi
echo UART_FTRACE_FUNCTIONS
if test -f /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_filter_functions; then awk '/uart_insert_char|tty_flip_buffer_push|sdp.*uart|sdp.*rx|uart.*rx/{print}' /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_filter_functions; fi
echo CONFIG_OPTIONS
if test -f /proc/config.gz; then gzip -dc /proc/config.gz | awk '/^CONFIG_(KPROBES|KALLSYMS|FTRACE|FUNCTION_TRACER|KPROBE_EVENTS|DYNAMIC_FTRACE|IKCONFIG)/{print}'; fi
echo BOOT_END; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
